rationale: The user explicitly requested an 'IRON MAN - JARVIS' style AI assistant with a dark futuristic HUD. To avoid the generic 'AI Teal/Purple' trope, we are using a 'Tactical HUD' aesthetic: Deep Obsidian Black mixed with Burnished Gold/Laser Amber. This provides a high-end, elite performance feel (Archetype 2 + 7 fusion) suited for a sassy, highly capable personal assistant.

motion_and_interactions.typing_indicator: Use 3 fading dots or a subtle pulsing glow on the AI's avatar ring using Animated APIs.
motion_and_interactions.voice_activation: Scale transform with Spring animation when mic is held down. The waveform should be driven by random or actual mic input amplitudes.
motion_and_interactions.hud_reveal: List items and chat messages should fade in and translate Y upwards by 10px on entry.

ai_core_avatar.description: Abstract 3D glowing sphere made of intricate golden, amber, and neon orange geometric wireframes. Use as the central 'JARVIS' entity visualization, possibly spinning or pulsing.

dark_hud_background.description: Macro photography of black matte metal texture with a subtle glowing orange-red laser line. Use as the app's main background behind the ScrollView.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (TouchableOpacity, Pressable, TextInput) and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` (React Native's equivalent to data-testid) attribute. Example: `testID="mic-button"`.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets 4.5:1 ratio against the dark backgrounds. The Amber (#FFB800) against Void Black (#050505) provides excellent contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use HTML/CSS or Tailwind CSS. Use exclusively React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, TextInput, Animated) and StyleSheet.create().
Target Android primarily. Keep layouts flexible using Flexbox.
Use the 'ai_core_avatar' image as the centerpiece of the voice interaction screen, potentially wrapping it in an animated pulse ring.

For the chat interface, style it like a 'Terminal/HUD' log rather than a traditional iMessage app. Use the `technical` font for timestamps and metadata, adding 1px solid borders to components for a tactical look.
Implement the Voice Waveform component as a series of Animated.View bars that scale vertically.
Ensure the 'Sassy' personality is reflected in the placeholder texts, initial greeting, and system prompts.
Build out the multi-turn memory, conversation history, search functionalities, and quick actions mentioned in the requirements.
Remember to attach `testID` to all buttons, inputs, and major views to comply with the testing rule.
